Shared named style values such as colours and sizes, used across the interface.

sections.name: File setup, box, pts
sections.title: Test setup and sample data
sections.what: Imports the render helper, the test runner, the geometry helpers, the swing chart and the meter. Defines a small drawing box and four sample points with time and win probability values.
sections.why: Gives the chart tests a fixed, simple drawing area and data to draw.
sections.watch_out: The sample values are fake, so they do not show how real matches would look.

sections.name: charts: geometry
sections.title: Checks chart maths
sections.what: Checks the math behind the win-probability chart: how time and percentage map to screen positions, how the SVG line path is built, and how large swings are found. Values outside the 0 to 100 percent range are clipped to the edges.
sections.why: The chart is drawn from these calculations, so a small error would show a wrong picture to users. Testing the maths alone is quicker and clearer than testing the drawing.
sections.watch_out: Changing the chart box size or the swing threshold will change the expected numbers in these tests.

sections.name: charts: components render with tokens only
sections.title: Checks chart components render safely
sections.what: Renders the swing chart and the meter component to HTML and checks for accessible labels, the honest empty state, a labelled scenario estimate, a data table, and that only theme colour tokens are used rather than raw hex colours.
sections.why: The app must describe charts in words for screen readers and must keep colours inside the shared design tokens.
sections.watch_out: The hex colour check will fail if someone adds a raw colour value directly into a component.

summary: Tests the chart drawing helpers and components that show win probability and swings, checking that they render using only the design tokens. Only the first section was provided, so the rest of this file could not be described.
purpose: Checks the chart geometry functions and that chart components render correctly.
why: Likely reason: charts must draw consistently from the same shared styling values.
